en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a hillside settlement of whitewashed cubic houses built on a rocky slope above the sea. A line of people in dark clothing stand along a stone wall in the foreground. The architecture is typical of Cycladic islands with terraced buildings and narrow paths. There is a stamp with a circular postmark in the upper left corner and Greek text printed vertically along the right edge.
